digest: src/ has 3 files (workflow-stop.ts, workflow-cancellation.ts, workflow-terminal.ts); no tests exist. Several spec mismatches are visible: S3 poll defaults, S6 message fallback, C1 extra cancel markers, T3 field name.

implementationMap.observedBehavior: Default poll is 200ms and the floor is 1ms. The spec requires a 50ms default and a 10ms floor.
Abort happens on either a disk stop intent or an aborted foreground launch signal for the same run path key.

implementationMap.evidence: const intent = await readWorkflowStopIntent(cwd, runId).catch(() => undefined);
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Read errors in the watcher are swallowed and do not count as stop, matching S4.
No catch, so read errors propagate to the caller, matching S4.
Only clears the interval. The initial check plus interval ticks are the only read starters, so no new reads start after dispose. Matches S5 by inspection.
Also matches by message prefix, which violates S6 (only the error name may qualify).
Creates an Error named WorkflowStopRequested with message workflow stop requested for <runId>, matching S2.
Disposer removes the signal and deletes the map entry when the last one goes; guards against stale sets. Matches S7 by inspection.
Map keyed by workflowRunPath(cwd, runId) holds aborted-check sources for S1 path (b).

implementationMap.evidence: if (candidate === "aborted" || candidate === "AbortError" || candidate === "ABORT_ERR" || candidate === "cancelled" || candidate === "timeout") return true;
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Accepts cancelled and timeout in addition to the three required strings, which violates C1.
Also treats cancelled:true and details.cancelled:true as cancellation, beyond the exact string rule in C1.

Recurses on parsed JSON from content text. Each parse yields a fresh object, so the identity guard is effectively dead. Recursion depth is bounded by finite nesting, so there is no infinite loop by inspection.
Matches AbortError by name for DOMException or plain records.

implementationMap.component: Terminal semantic status for completed runs
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Completed run with a degradation record maps to completed_degraded, matching T1.
Unreadable control.json yields undefined, falling through to completed_without_semantic_result, matching T2.
Unknown or missing control status maps to completed_without_semantic_result. Incomplete tasks take precedence over control status.
outputRetryAttempts sums across all tasks (matches T3). The launch count is exposed as launchRetries, not the public contract name launchRetryAttempts required by T3.
Interface field name launchRetries diverges from the required launchRetryAttempts public contract.

unmappedAreas: store.js functions (readWorkflowStopIntent, workflowRunPath, finalStageTasks, readJson, fromProjectPath, isTerminalWorkflowStatus, workflowRunDir) are not in the repo
types.js (WorkflowRunRecord) is not in the repo
No unit test files found anywhere in the repo (Q1 unmapped)
notes: SPEC S3 requires 50ms default and 10ms floor; src uses 200ms default and 1ms floor.
SPEC T3 requires launchRetryAttempts; src uses launchRetries.
SPEC C1 allows only aborted, AbortError, ABORT_ERR; src also accepts cancelled and timeout plus cancelled flags.
SPEC S6 forbids message-based matching; src has a message-prefix fallback.
tsconfig includes src/**/*.ts; typecheck will fail on unresolved imports because store.js and types.js are absent.
Stage maps evidence only; no conformance claimed.
